---
title: "Browse the palettes"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(rglyos)
```

Every colorway in rglyos, with its colors, where it came from, and a photo of
the figure it was sampled from. Filter by company, product line or what kind of
plot it suits, click a swatch to copy its hex code, and use **Suggest a change**
on any card to open a prefilled GitHub issue where you can propose different
colors or attach a cleaner photograph.

```{r data, results = "asis"}
stats <- glyos_palette_stats()
cw <- glyos_colorways
cw$colours <- unname(glyos_palettes[cw$palette])
cw <- merge(cw, stats[, c("palette", "min_de", "min_de_deutan", "min_de_protan",
                          "min_de_tritan", "lum_range", "hue_spread",
                          "categorical", "colorblind", "sequential", "diverging")],
            by = "palette", sort = FALSE)
cw <- cw[order(match(cw$palette, names(glyos_palettes))), ]
num <- c("min_de", "min_de_deutan", "min_de_protan", "min_de_tritan",
         "lum_range", "hue_spread")
cw[num] <- lapply(cw[num], round, 1)
payload <- list(
  generated = format(Sys.Date()),
  version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("rglyos")),
  repo = "https://github.com/bmaitner/rglyos",
  palettes = cw
)
json <- jsonlite::toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null", dataframe = "rows")
json <- gsub("</", "<\\/", json, fixed = TRUE)
cat('<script id="glyos-data" type="application/json">', json, '</script>', sep = "\n")
```

<style>
.gb-controls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: .6rem .9rem; align-items: end; margin: 1rem 0 .5rem; }
.gb-controls label { display: block; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .2rem; }
.gb-controls input[type=text], .gb-controls select { width: 100%; padding: .35rem .5rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; font-size: .9rem; }
.gb-uses { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .35rem .9rem; margin: .3rem 0 .8rem; font-size: .85rem; }
.gb-uses label { font-weight: 500; }
.gb-count { font-size: .85rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: .6rem; }
.gb-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
.gb-card { border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; padding: .8rem .9rem; background: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .45rem; }
.gb-card h4 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; }
.gb-meta { font-size: .8rem; color: #555; }
.gb-meta b { color: #222; }
.gb-strip { display: flex; height: 56px; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; }
.gb-strip button { flex: 1; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; position: relative; font: inherit; }
.gb-strip button span { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 3px; font-size: .62rem; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; text-align: center; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s; padding: 1px 0; }
.gb-strip button:hover span, .gb-strip button:focus span { opacity: 1; }

<div class="gb-controls">
  <div><label for="gb-q">Search</label><input id="gb-q" type="text" placeholder="name, colorway, description"></div>
  <div><label for="gb-company">Company</label><select id="gb-company"><option value="">All companies</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="gb-line">Product line</label><select id="gb-line"><option value="">All lines</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="gb-n">Colors</label><select id="gb-n"><option value="">Any number</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="gb-sort">Sort by</label><select id="gb-sort"><option value="default">Package order</option><option value="palette">Name</option><option value="company">Company</option><option value="year">Year</option><option value="min_de">Most distinct colors</option><option value="cvd">Most colorblind-safe</option><option value="lum_range">Widest lightness range</option></select></div>
</div>
<div class="gb-uses">
  <span>Suits:</span>
  <label><input type="checkbox" class="gb-use" value="categorical"> categorical</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" class="gb-use" value="colorblind"> colorblind-safe</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" class="gb-use" value="sequential"> sequential</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" class="gb-use" value="diverging"> diverging</label>
  <label style="margin-left:auto"><input type="checkbox" id="gb-photos"> show photos</label>
</div>
<div class="gb-count" id="gb-count"></div>
<div class="gb-grid" id="gb-grid"></div>
<div class="gb-toast" id="gb-toast">Copied</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("glyos-data").textContent);
  var pals = data.palettes;
  var repo = data.repo;
  var grid = document.getElementById("gb-grid");
  var count = document.getElementById("gb-count");
  var toast = document.getElementById("gb-toast");
  var q = document.getElementById("gb-q");
  var selCompany = document.getElementById("gb-company");
  var selLine = document.getElementById("gb-line");
  var selN = document.getElementById("gb-n");
  var selSort = document.getElementById("gb-sort");
  var showPhotos = document.getElementById("gb-photos");
  var uses = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".gb-use"));

  function uniq(arr) { return arr.filter(function (v, i, a) { return a.indexOf(v) === i; }); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]; }); }
  function textColor(hex) {
    var r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16), g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16), b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
    return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) > 150 ? "#111" : "#fff";
  }
  function fill(sel, values, keepFirst) {
    values.forEach(function (v) { var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = v; o.textContent = v; sel.appendChild(o); });
  }
  var companies = uniq(pals.map(function (p) { return p.company; }));
  companies = ["Onell Design"].concat(companies.filter(function (c) { return c !== "Onell Design"; }).sort());
  fill(selCompany, companies);
  function refreshLines() {
    var current = selLine.value;
    selLine.innerHTML = '<option value="">All lines</option>';
    var lines = uniq(pals.filter(function (p) { return !selCompany.value || p.company === selCompany.value; }).map(function (p) { return p.line; })).sort();
    fill(selLine, lines);
    selLine.value = lines.indexOf(current) >= 0 ? current : "";
  }
  refreshLines();

  function issueUrl(p) {
    var params = new URLSearchParams({
      template: "palette-correction.yml",
      title: "[" + p.palette + "] palette change",
      labels: "palette",
      palette: p.palette,
      current_colours: p.colours.join(" "),
      reference: p.source
    });
    return repo + "/issues/new?" + params.toString();
  }
  function photoIssueUrl(p) {
    var params = new URLSearchParams({
      template: "photo-submission.yml",
      title: "[" + p.palette + "] cleaner reference photo",
      labels: "photo",
      palette: p.palette,
      reference: p.source
    });
    return repo + "/issues/new?" + params.toString();
  }

  function card(p) {
    var strip = p.colours.map(function (h) {
      return '<button type="button" data-hex="' + h + '" title="Copy ' + h + '" style="background:' + h + '"><span style="color:' + textColor(h) + '">' + h + '</span></button>';
    }).join("");
    var hexes = p.colours.map(function (h) { return '<code data-hex="' + h + '">' + h + "</code>"; }).join("");
    var badges = ["categorical", "colorblind", "sequential", "diverging"].map(function (u) {
      return '<span class="gb-badge' + (p[u] ? " on" : "") + '">' + u + "</span>";
    }).join("");
    var when = [p.year, p.wave].filter(function (x) { return x != null && x !== ""; }).join(", ");
    return '<div class="gb-card' + (showPhotos.checked ? " show-photo" : "") + '" data-palette="' + esc(p.palette) + '">' +
      "<h4>" + esc(p.palette) + "</h4>" +
      '<div class="gb-meta"><b>' + esc(p.colorway) + "</b> &middot; " + esc(p.company) + " &middot; " + esc(p.line) + (when ? " &middot; " + esc(when) : "") + "</div>" +
      '<div class="gb-strip">' + strip + "</div>" +
      '<div class="gb-hex">' + hexes + "</div>" +
      '<p class="gb-desc">' + esc(p.description) + "</p>" +
      '<div class="gb-badges">' + badges + "</div>" +
      '<div class="gb-stats">min &Delta;E ' + p.min_de + " (deutan " + p.min_de_deutan + ", protan " + p.min_de_protan + ", tritan " + p.min_de_tritan + ") &middot; lightness range " + p.lum_range + " &middot; hue spread " + p.hue_spread + "&deg;</div>" +
      '<div class="gb-code"><code>glyos_palette("' + esc(p.palette) + '")</code></div>' +
      '<div class="gb-photo"><a href="' + esc(p.image) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img loading="lazy" src="' + esc(p.image) + '" alt="Reference photo: ' + esc(p.reference_figure) + '"></a></div>' +
      '<div class="gb-links">' +
        '<a href="' + esc(p.source) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Reference: ' + esc(p.reference_figure) + "</a>" +
        '<a href="' + esc(p.image) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Photo</a>' +
        '<a class="gb-suggest" href="' + issueUrl(p) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Suggest a change</a>' +
        '<a href="' + photoIssueUrl(p) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Submit a cleaner photo</a>' +
      "</div>" +
    "</div>";
  }

  function render() {
    var terms = q.value.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    var wantUses = uses.filter(function (u) { return u.checked; }).map(function (u) { return u.value; });
    var out = pals.filter(function (p) {
      if (selCompany.value && p.company !== selCompany.value) return false;
      if (selLine.value && p.line !== selLine.value) return false;
      if (selN.value && p.colours.length !== +selN.value) return false;
      for (var i = 0; i < wantUses.length; i++) if (!p[wantUses[i]]) return false;
      if (terms.length) {
        var hay = [p.palette, p.colorway, p.company, p.line, p.description, p.reference_figure].join(" ").toLowerCase();
        for (var j = 0; j < terms.length; j++) if (hay.indexOf(terms[j]) < 0) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
    var s = selSort.value;
    if (s === "palette" || s === "company") out.sort(function (a, b) { return a[s] < b[s] ? -1 : a[s] > b[s] ? 1 : a.palette < b.palette ? -1 : 1; });
    else if (s === "year") out.sort(function (a, b) { return (b.year || 0) - (a.year || 0); });
    else if (s === "min_de" || s === "lum_range") out.sort(function (a, b) { return b[s] - a[s]; });
    else if (s === "cvd") out.sort(function (a, b) { return Math.min(b.min_de_deutan, b.min_de_protan, b.min_de_tritan) - Math.min(a.min_de_deutan, a.min_de_protan, a.min_de_tritan); });
    count.textContent = out.length + " of " + pals.length + " palettes (rglyos " + data.version + ", " + data.generated + ")";
    grid.innerHTML = out.length ? out.map(card).join("") : '<div class="gb-empty">No palettes match. Loosen a filter, or propose a new colorway with the link below.</div>';
  }

  function copy(hex) {
    var done = function () { toast.textContent = "Copied " + hex; toast.classList.add("show"); setTimeout(function () { toast.classList.remove("show"); }, 1200); };
    if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(hex).then(done, done); else done();
  }
  grid.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var t = e.target.closest("[data-hex]");
    if (t) { e.preventDefault(); copy(t.getAttribute("data-hex")); }
  });
  [q, selLine, selN, selSort].forEach(function (el) { el.addEventListener("input", render); el.addEventListener("change", render); });
  selCompany.addEventListener("change", function () { refreshLines(); render(); });
  uses.forEach(function (u) { u.addEventListener("change", render); });
  showPhotos.addEventListener("change", function () {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(grid.querySelectorAll(".gb-card"), function (c) { c.classList.toggle("show-photo", showPhotos.checked); });
  });

  // Deep links: ?company=TheGodBeast&use=colorblind&q=spectre
  var qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if (qs.get("company")) selCompany.value = qs.get("company");
  refreshLines();
  if (qs.get("line")) selLine.value = qs.get("line");
  if (qs.get("q")) q.value = qs.get("q");
  if (qs.get("use")) uses.forEach(function (u) { u.checked = qs.get("use").split(",").indexOf(u.value) >= 0; });
  render();
})();
</script>

## Suggesting changes

Every palette here is an approximation read off a photograph, so corrections
are welcome. Each card links to a prefilled GitHub issue form:

- **Suggest a change** if a color is wrong, missing, or should be removed. Say
  which hex codes you would add, change or drop and why; a photo of the figure
  under neutral light is the best evidence.
- **Submit a cleaner photo** if you have a shot of the figure on a plain
  background. Cleaner photos let the color sampling run without picking up
  rocks, tables and studio walls. You can drag an image straight into the
  issue form.
- [Propose a new colorway](https://github.com/bmaitner/rglyos/issues/new?template=new-palette.yml)
  if a figure or wave you care about is not covered yet.

You need a GitHub account to open an issue. If you would rather not, email the
maintainer listed in the package DESCRIPTION.
